arxiv-2103-10933.title: Hypothesis Tests on Rayleigh Wave Radiation Pattern Shapes: A Theoretical Assessment of Idealized Source Screening
arxiv-2103-10933.creator: Joshua D. Carmichael
arxiv-2103-10933.description: Abstract Shallow seismic sources excite Rayleigh wave ground motion with azimuthally dependent radiation patterns. We place binary hypothesis tests on theoretical models of such radiation patterns to screen cylindrically symmetric sources (like explosions) from non-symmetric sources (like non-vertical dip-slip, or non-VDS faults).

arxiv-2105-05843.creator: Daniel Álvarez-Gavela, David Darrow
arxiv-2105-05843.description: Abstract . For each positive integer n n , we give a geometric description of the stably trivial elements of the group π n ​ U n / O n \pi_{n}U_{n}/O_{n} . In particular, we show that all such elements admit representatives whose tangencies with respect to a fixed Lagrangian plane consist only of folds.

arxiv-2109-06842.title: Fast, high precision autofocus on a motorised microscope: automating blood sample imaging on the OpenFlexure Microscope
arxiv-2109-06842.creator: Joe Knapper, Joel T. Collins, Julian Stirling, Samuel McDermott, William Wadsworth, Richard Bowman
arxiv-2109-06842.description: Abstract The OpenFlexure Microscope is a 3D printed, low-cost microscope capable of automated image acquisition through the use of a motorised translation stage and a Raspberry Pi imaging system. This automation has applications in research and healthcare, including in supporting the diagnosis of malaria in low resource settings.

arxiv-2307-07139.title: Phase-Field Simulations for Dripping-to-Jetting Transitions: Effects of Low Interfacial Tension and Bulk Diffusion
arxiv-2307-07139.creator: Fukeng Huang, Weizhu Bao, Tiezheng Qian
arxiv-2307-07139.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fukeng Huang, Weizhu Bao, Tiezheng Qian. The dripping-to-jetting transitions in coaxial flows have been experimentally well studied for systems of high interfacial tension, where the capillary number of the outer fluid and the Weber number of the inner fluid are in control. Recent experiments have shown that in systems of low interfacial tension, the transitions driven by the inner flow are no longer dominated by the inertial force alone, and the viscous drag force due to the inner flow is also quantitatively important.

arxiv-2509-24011.title: Resonance Contributions to Charged-Current (Anti)Neutrino-Nucleon Elastic Scattering at GeV Energies
arxiv-2509-24011.creator: Oleksandr Tomalak
arxiv-2509-24011.description: Abstract We present the first evaluation of virtual resonance contributions to the charged-current (anti)neutrino-nucleon elastic scattering at GeV energies, focusing on the dominant \Delta(1232) resonance. We approximate the vector part of the N\to\Delta transition by the leading magnetic dipole term.

pmc-11320419.creator: Fangfang Zhong, Lijun Song, Hao li, Jing Liu, Chunyan Liu, Qulian Guo, Wenjun Liu
pmc-11320419.description: BackgroundThe FCN1 gene encodes the ficolin-1 protein, implicated in the pathogenesis of various diseases, though its precise role in tumorigenesis remains elusive. This study aims to elucidate the prognostic significance, immune signature, and treatment response associated with FCN1 across diverse cancer types.

pmc-12555564.title: Validating a protein screening test for the Finnish oldest-olds
pmc-12555564.creator: R T Niskanen, A Ranta, M H Suominen, K H Pitkälä
pmc-12555564.description: BackgroundThe population of older adults (≥65 years), especially the subgroup of oldest-olds (≥80 years), is growing rapidly. Despite the importance of adequate intake, protein intake is often suboptimal. There is a need for a simple, efficient and feasible protein-specific dietary assessment tool. Thus, a novel protein screening test adapted to the Finnish cultural context was developed.

pmc-13088959.creator: Juan M Ardavin-Ituarte, Olynka Vega-Vega, Salvador Lopez-Gil, Jesus Manolo Ramos-Gordillo, Jackeline Anzures-Enriquez, Jose Carlos Peña-Rodriguez, Junichi Ishigami, MEXHEMO Collaborative Group

In the absence of a national hemodialysis (HD) registry, epidemiological data on patient characteristics, treatment practices, and outcomes remain scarce. pmc-13255087.creator: Cecilie Beinert, Anita Nistås, Eli Anne Myrvoll, Frøydis Nordgård Vik, Margrethe Røed
pmc-13255087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesEstablishing healthy dietary patterns in childhood lowers the risk of developing non-communicable diseases. After-school programs are important settings in public health work, as they reach a majority of young students and shape everyday food and meal practices.The aim of this study was to explore students’ experiences of being “food agents”, a central role in an intervention aiming to increase food literacy competencies.

pmc-13408623.title: Effects of Calcium Silicate-Based Sealer Residues on Adhesive Bonding to Coronal Dentin: An in Vitro Study
pmc-13408623.creator: Mariana Bena Gelio, Thais Piragine Leandrin, Ana Lídia Pinheiro Silva Sato, Milton Carlos Kuga, Joissi Ferrari Zaniboni
pmc-13408623.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction: This study aimed to evaluate the influence of residues from three endodontic sealers on the adhesive interface of two universal adhesive systems: Scotchbond Universal (SU) and OptiBond All-in-One (OU).Methods: Forty bovine dentin surfaces were cleaned with 95% ethanol and divided into 4 groups: control, without endodontic sealer; AH, dentin impregnated with AH PLUS sealer; ES, EndoSequence BC Sealer; and MTA, MTA Fillapex. After cleaning, the persistence of residues and the number of open dentinal tubules were analyzed by scanning electron microscopy.

pmc-13598179.title: Euphorbia kansui for latent virus reactivation in people living with HIV on suppressive antiretroviral therapy: A phase 1b/2a clinical trial
pmc-13598179.creator: Jingna Xun, Xinyi Yang, Jun Chen, Luling Wu, Jiangrong Wang, Zichen Song, Li Liu, Zhenyan Wang, Wei Song, Tangkai Qi, Yang Tang, Junyang Yang, Min Zhang, Wenkang Jin, Meiyan Sun, Chaoyu Chen, Yueming Shao, Zhihang Zheng, Yuqi Zhu, Xinyu Zhang, Renfang Zhang, Yinzhong Shen, Hongzhou Lu, Huanzhang Zhu

Our study explores Euphorbia kansui (Kansui), a traditional Chinese medicine, for its potential to reverse HIV latency while rigorously assessing safety.MethodsWe conducted a phase 1b/2a clinical trial at the Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center (NCT04503928).

pmc-13640175.title: A novel pH-responsive nanoreactor for pyroptosis induction: multifaceted ROS amplification drives potent immunotherapy against triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-13640175.creator: Wenjia Liu, Ying Wang, Xiangyu Hao, Yangxun Wang, Xiaofan Zhang, Jinchao Zhang, Kun Ge, Guoqiang Zhou
pmc-13640175.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is associated with rapid progression and poor sensitivity to monotherapies, necessitating combination strategies to enhance tumor immunogenicity, reprogram the tumor microenvironment (TME), and convert immunologically “cold” tumors into “hot” ones. In this study, we develop a pH-responsive, pyroptosis-inducing nanoreactor, ZnS/ZIF-90:Fe/Vk3 (ZZFV), designed to elicit potent antitumor immunity.

uslaw-usc-t37-s207.title: 37 U.S.C. § 207 — Band leaders
uslaw-usc-t37-s207.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t37-s207.description: United States Code, Title 37 (Pay And Allowances Of The Uniformed Services); Chapter 3 (Basic Pay). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The leader of the Army Band is entitled to the basic pay of a captain in the Army. (b) The leader of the United States Navy Band is entitled to the basic pay of a lieutenant in the Navy. (c).
